profile_text.body:
Genpact LTD is listed as a public company with the ticker G, headquartered in Hamilton, D0, and identified by CIK 0001398659. The website associated with the entry is generali.com.

The text harvested from that site does not describe Genpact. It describes Assicurazioni Generali Group and its corporate website, which the site says carries information about the group's activities, financial data, news, corporate social responsibility, career opportunities, and history. The same text refers to a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence," which it says will enhance customer relationships, the group operating model, and core capabilities.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for Genpact LTD. The name, ticker, headquarters, and filing identifier on one side and the harvested website text on the other point to two different organizations.
